The '''''Core Guardian''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] auxiliary [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that was destroyed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gurlanin]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] claimed responsibility for the destruction of the vessel by leaking troop readiness information to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. ''Core Guardian''{{'s}} defensive [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] was offline during an unscheduled maintenance and no survivors were reported.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
